# little unknown

> little unknown is a product studio founded by Naman Vashistha that makes apps for iPhone, Android and the web. Its tagline is "everything starts unknown".

Most products start as a small question that nobody has answered well yet. The studio calls those questions little unknowns and builds its products around them. It works by three principles: question everything, build to find out, and ship what matters.

The name is written "little unknown", in lowercase, as two words. The logo is a band of dots with three lit in vermilion, next to the word "unknown" with a small "little" above it. Brand guidelines and logo files are at https://littleunknown.com/brand/.

## Pages

- [Home](https://littleunknown.com/): the studio, its products and how it works
- [About](https://littleunknown.com/about/): what the studio is, what the name means, who runs it and what it has made
- [Brand](https://littleunknown.com/brand/): logo, colours, type, voice and logo files
- [Blog](https://littleunknown.com/blog/): posts about the studio and its products ([RSS](https://littleunknown.com/rss.xml))

## Products

- [Calm Chess](https://namanvashistha.com/chess/cozychess/): a chess app for iPhone and Android, subtitled "A kind coach beside you". After each move, a coach says whether it was great, good or a slip, and why. You can play three opponents, from the Rookie to the Grandmaster, or pass the phone to a friend. There's no account and there are no ads, and the engine runs offline on the phone. It's available in English, Hindi and Spanish, and it's coming to the App Store and Google Play.
